# ITraceWriter

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Diagnostics` · interface

```csharp
public interface ITraceWriter
```

Where trace output goes. Set one on [`Trace.Writer`](Trace.md#writer) to send it to your own logging.

## Methods

### Write

```csharp
void Write(TraceLevel level, uint tag, string? message, Exception? exception)
```

Types: [`TraceLevel`](TraceLevel.md)

Records a tagged event with an optional message and exception.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `level` | How much it matters. [`Trace.MinLevel`](Trace.md#minlevel) has already been applied, except to `Trace.WriteDebug`, which is [`TraceLevel.Verbose`](TraceLevel.md#verbose) and always arrives in Debug builds. |
| `tag` | The number that identifies the call site. |
| `message` | The message, if any. |
| `exception` | The exception, if any. |
